A full card image with the corrected text and a black E at the lower right corner, outside the card's frame, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ESB2P-L-lonerogue-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the 2017 slip. This is a full card image again, with a black italic “E” at the lower right corner outside the card frame.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the E card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
